# Unproject

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Unproject a screen position to a lat/lng point. Requires the ViewState and dimensions.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/unproject",
  "type": "UnprojectOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/unproject').par.screenPosition` (an input) and `op('/unproject').out.point` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.screenPosition`, `out.point`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `screenPosition` | `Vec2Field` | `{"x":0,"y":0}` |
| `width` | `NumberField` | `1920` |
| `height` | `NumberField` | `1080` |
| `viewState` | `CompoundPropsField` | `{"latitude":40.7128,"longitude":-74.006,"zoom":12,"pitch":0,"bearing":0}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `point` | `Point2DField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
